pr_title: [Performance][Ops] Integrate Kimi K3 fused norm gate and attention residual
source_quote:
Unconditionally importing `apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate` will cause an `ImportError` when Triton is not available, breaking the CPU/CANN fallback path. Import it conditionally using `HAS_TRITON`.
> ```suggestion
from vllm.triton_utils import HAS_TRITON
> if HAS_TRITON:
from vllm_ascend.ops.triton.kda.fused_norm_gate import apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate
else:
apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate = None

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha f1acbea 体现修改

rule.description: 从 Triton kernel 模块导入函数时，必须使用 `HAS_TRITON` 进行条件导入，否则在 Triton 不可用的环境（如 CPU/CANN fallback）下会触发 `ImportError`。
checkpoints: 检查是否存在从 `vllm_ascend.ops.triton.*` 模块的直接（非条件）导入
确认 Triton kernel 函数导入是否用 `HAS_TRITON` 包裹
确认非 Triton 环境下导入的函数是否有默认值（如 `None`）

pattern.code:
from typing import Callable, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

from vllm.attention.backends.abstract import AttentionBackend
from vllm.config import VllmConfig
from vllm.triton_utils import HAS_TRITON

# Triton 导入改为条件导入，非 Triton 环境下默认为 None
from vllm_ascend.ops.triton.kda.kda import fused_kda_gate

apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate: (
    Callable[
        [torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, float],
        torch.Tensor,
    ]
    | None
) = None
if HAS_TRITON:
    from vllm_ascend.ops.triton.kda.fused_norm_gate import (
        apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate as triton_apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate,
    )

    apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate = triton_apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate


class KimiKDAModel(nn.Module):
    """Kimi KDA model with fused Triton kernels."""

    def __init__(self, config, ...):
        super().__init__()
        self.o_norm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
        # ...

    def forward(self, ...):
        # ...
